findings.description: The restart/registry test exercises LocalH3VideoProviderFamily with LocalVideoProviderDouble, whose preflight() is a no-op, and the test submits without calling family.preflight(). Real Comfy T8 and T8 Turbo adapters require an exact preflight marker before submit, while VideoGenerationService.submit_local_once() does not call preflight automatically.
findings.recommendation: Use a preflight-enforcing child double or a focused adapter seam, call family.preflight() before submit, and assert the restarted path preserves the preflight/permit/submit contract without a second submit.

findings.description: Most family dispatch tests use SimpleNamespace requests, submissions, observations, and permissive duck-typed children. They prove routing branches but bypass Pydantic sealed request/submission/observation validation and permit the child to accept values that production adapters reject.
findings.recommendation: Keep the lightweight routing tests, then add a small typed fixture set covering sealed requests and submissions plus tampered-but-resealed cross-generation and cross-submission negatives.
